instruction:
Three-Area Split Layout From Init Model. Work in the opened OpenStudio application, starting from the Desktop input files init.osm and weather.epw. Use init_plan.png on the Desktop as the visual reference for the target layout. Modify the model rather than replacing the task package with an unrelated file. Save result.osm in the task output folder.

Create 1 building story, 3 spaces and 3 thermal zones. Use these exact OS:Space names: Area-A, Area-B and Area-C. Every space must be assigned to a building story and a thermal zone, and each space must have more than 0.05 m2 of floor area.

Model the enclosure with 18 total OS:Surface objects, split into 3 floor surfaces, 3 roof/ceiling surfaces and 12 wall surfaces; the surface outside-boundary counts should be 3 Ground, 11 Outdoors and 4 Surface.

Add 3 OS:SubSurface objects, all of them FixedWindow windows, with total fixed-window area 15.36 m2 within +/-0.50 m2.

Include the required internal-load and zone system metadata: 3 ideal-loads air systems, 3 zone HVAC equipment lists and 3 dual-setpoint thermostats.

Set the geometry so the overall surface-geometry bounding box spans 24.00 m in X, 8.00 m in Y and 3.20 m in Z, each within +/-0.05 m, total floor surface area 192.00 m2 within +/-0.50 m2 and total exterior wall gross area 204.80 m2 within +/-0.50 m2.

Other model details may vary as long as the saved outputs satisfy these stated requirements.
